_comment: Applied only to the text sent to the English voice (am_adam), never to what the screen shows. Whole words, case-sensitive, longest first. Respellings are lowercase English letters (capitals get spelled out letter by letter) that the US phonemizer reads close to the Italian; check one with tool/voice/generate.py --lang en --say '...'. Numbers are spelled out by spoken_numbers.py (years as 'nineteen twenty-nine').
